title: NucleoMag Virus Viral DNA/RNA Isolation
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Elution solution is added to the samples.
Beads are resuspended in elution solution.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify number of samples (1‑96, divisible by 8), deepwell plate type, reservoir type, starting sample volume (µL), binding‑buffer volume (µL), elution volume (µL), tip parking option, and P300 multi‑channel mount (left or right).

steps.title: Mix binding buffer
steps.instruction: Mix the binding buffer five times to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified binding‑buffer volume (µL) into each sample well of the deep‑well plate placed on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnet and incubate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module and incubate for 7 minutes to allow nucleic‑acid bound beads to collect.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well into the liquid‑waste container.

steps.title: First wash – add and mix
steps.instruction: Add the first wash buffer to each well and resuspend the beads by mixing.

steps.title: First wash – remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the wash supernatant into the liquid‑waste container.

steps.title: Second wash – add and mix
steps.instruction: Add the second wash buffer to each well and resuspend the beads by mixing.

steps.title: Second wash – remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the second wash supernatant into the liquid‑waste container.

steps.title: Third wash – add without mixing
steps.instruction: Add the third wash buffer to each well without resuspending the beads.

steps.title: Third wash – remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the third wash supernatant into the liquid‑waste container.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on the magnetic module for 1 minute to air‑dry the beads.

steps.title: Add elution solution
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified elution volume (µL) of elution solution into each well.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in elution
steps.instruction: Mix the beads thoroughly to resuspend them in the elution solution.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 5 minutes to allow nucleic acids to elute.

steps.title: Engage magnet and settle
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module and incubate for 7 minutes (variable settling time) to capture beads.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared eluate from each well to the elution plate located in Slot 1 of the deck.
